texts: To the left of the grassy outfield is the dirt infield.
To the right of the grassy outfield is the dirt infield.
Above home plate is the pitcher's mound.
Below home plate is the pitcher's mound.
Along the right side of the sandy shore is the sea.
Along the left side of the sandy shore is the sea.
The facing rows of boats flank a channel oriented from top to bottom.
The facing rows of boats flank a channel oriented from left to right.
The two rows of houses face each other across a street oriented from top to bottom.
The two rows of houses face each other across a street oriented from left to right.
The two roads cross with the more vertical roadway above the more horizontal roadway.
The two roads cross with the more vertical roadway below the more horizontal roadway.
The road running from upper left to lower right forms the upper level of the crossing.
The road running from upper left to lower right forms the lower level of the crossing.
Adjacent long rows of parked vehicles are separated vertically.
Adjacent long rows of parked vehicles are separated horizontally.
On the upper-left side of the river is the road that follows its bank.
On the lower-right side of the river is the road that follows its bank.
Above the main house is its rectangular swimming pool.
Below the main house is its rectangular swimming pool.
The main house is approached by a driveway coming from the top of the image.
The main house is approached by a driveway coming from the bottom of the image.
Below the tank site is the roadway.
Above the tank site is the roadway.
To the right of the adjacent vertical road is the round tank.
To the left of the adjacent vertical road is the round tank.
Above the tennis courts is the parking area.
Below the tennis courts is the parking area.
Around the house there is dense tree cover.
Around the house there is open dry ground.
Along both banks of the river there is bare dry ground.
Along both banks of the river there is dense green tree cover.
